specimen.reportedLocality: Laguna de Bay; source-corrected locality: Brgy. Calahan, Cardona, Rizal
specimen.collectionContext: Authors report a preserved specimen obtained from a fisherfolk catch at a fishery landing site. The paper gives no capture coordinates in its text; its Figure 1 sampling-location map is not transcribed or georeferenced in this review.
specimen.repository: Ateneo de Manila University Biodiversity Research Laboratory (ADMU)

heldLead.description: The article also mentions a July 2024 fisherfolk report from Talim Island, but that fish was not retained as a specimen.

decision.rationale: The full peer-reviewed short communication reports one preserved specimen examined by the authors and deposited in the ADMU collection, with collection date and a Laguna de Bay association. The official 2026 corrigendum corrects the locality from Brgy. Patunhay to Brgy. Calahan. The journal's official policy states CC BY-NC 3.0, so this attributed projection is explicitly noncommercial-only.

caveats: The source describes a specimen obtained from a fisherfolk catch at a landing site. No capture coordinates are given in the article text; its Figure 1 map is not georeferenced in this review or the app.
The corrigendum changes the specimen locality to Brgy. Calahan, Cardona, Rizal; the earlier Patunhay locality is superseded.
The separate Talim Island report is anecdotal and unvouchered, so it is excluded from this specimen assertion.
The 2025 report is historical. One specimen does not establish current presence, abundance, establishment, lake-wide distribution or a complete checklist.
The journal policy permits noncommercial reuse with attribution; this projection must not be used commercially without separate permission.

nonClaims: This is not a current-presence or abundance report and is not a complete Laguna de Bay fish inventory.
No exact capture point, coordinates or waterbody boundary are inferred from the barangay or landing-site locality; the article's Figure 1 is not georeferenced in this review.
The unvouchered Talim Island anecdote is not counted as a second specimen or occurrence.
This article does not provide diet, bait effectiveness, fishing permission or safety guidance.
